title: in Base overlays, add a ready per-test revert command or a FAIL-lines-only form so the reviewer does not need one run per test to see each FAIL line

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261127-154633-787b, project ork, item S620:

in Base overlays, add a ready per-test revert command or a FAIL-lines-only form so the reviewer does not need one run per test to see each FAIL line

Evidence: the overlay-1.json run with -run TestBaseOverlay printed over 20000 characters and was truncated, which hid some per-test FAIL lines
